title: Bookstore and outdoor mall
content: Last night- was in a regular type city scape, where people from my past were sleeping in a domino’s pizza store. Next to the pizza store, there was a decadent looking store with a man and woman letting people in. I realized the store was open all night and was happy. It was a humongous, fancy bookstore with lots of rooms and at least two floors. From the second floor, I exited out into a gorgeous outdoor mall scape. I loved it there and wished I had more time there. A kind of lazy river running through parts of it, with kids and adults riding on it. Lots of outdoor vendors and fancy looking stores. Was shocked all this was happening above the regular seeming pizza store where myself and people from my past had been staying the night.
